requirements.requirement: The system must render PI name, institution, trial count, publication indicator, and score contribution correctly when all fields are present.
The system must display formatted trial count as a non-negative integer with appropriate label (e.g., 'X trials').
The system must visually indicate publication presence when publication indicator is true.
The system must omit or replace missing PI fields with fallback text without breaking layout.
The system must render a fallback message when the entire PI object is null or undefined.
The system must ensure score contribution displayed in the UI matches the value provided by the API payload.
The system must maintain consistent formatting of PI fields across multiple renders with identical input data.
The system must not render undefined, null, or NaN values directly in the UI.
The system must correctly handle partial API responses where some PI fields are missing but others are present.
The system must preserve UI structure and alignment when long strings are provided for PI name or institution.
The system must pass all unit tests validating individual rendering functions for PI data transformation.
The system must pass integration tests confirming PI data flows from API response through transformation logic into rendered UI.
